image_prompt.text: Broken stone pillars and standing archway remnants scattered across the arena floor, tall enough for a retreating fighter to break combat lock behind them
Rubble-choked gaps in the collapsed curtain walls and ruined doorways into the keep, funnelling fighters into predictable flashpoints along the routes between the outer ring and the centre
Spawn platforms tucked behind the intact sections of the outer castle wall, screened from the keep's high ground
A large ruined castle keep at the centre of the map — a tall tower of dark grey weathered stone with broken walls, missing sections and spilled debris, the map's focal point and its highest ground
A ring of partially collapsed stone castle walls defining the arena boundary, some sections still standing intact and others crumbled into rubble
Several small ruined buildings scattered around the map — collapsed, moss-covered stone huts giving cover and tactical positions
Piles of broken stone blocks and debris strewn over the cracked stone ground of the arena as low cover

layout_placement.text: Spawns set back at the arena edge and out of the keep's sightlines, so a player is not exposed to the high ground the frame they appear

notes: Action rather than Shooter: the prompt is a shared clash space of cover, chokepoints and elevated positions in a medieval ruin, with no ranged weapons or firing corridors named.

Preset Fighting taken with its options intact (spawn-protected, cover-los, choke-bottleneck) but its arena-flat shape substituted for arena-tiered, because the prompt makes the keep the high ground and asks for verticality and elevated positions, which a single-level floor contradicts.

Archways and broken walls are read as tiered relief, not as walkable surfaces above the arena, so the map stays on P0 + tiered rather than P2. If the keep's upper levels are meant to be enterable floors overhanging the ground, that becomes an overhang build, which is not ready yet.

would have asked: Sounds like a melee fighting arena — a bounded ruined-castle clash space with pillar cover, chokepoints through the broken walls, and spawns screened from the centre — but terraced rather than flat, so the keep can be real high ground. That costs an elevation pass and nothing more. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: confirming the keep and the huts are solid ruined architecture you climb and fight around rather than buildings you walk inside — interiors would need a separate indoor pass that isn't ready yet.
would have asked: the walls bound the arena, so I've left out bottomless ring-out edges and combat pickups; say the word if you want either.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
No exact quantities were given — 'several' ruined buildings and 'some' intact wall sections are carried in the text rather than as counts.

The prompt asks for configurable attributes (MapSize, CastleHeight, WallIntegrity, DebrisAmount, NumberOfRuins, StoneColor, MossAmount); nothing in the handoff carries tunable parameters, so they are recorded here.
Overall aesthetic requested: dark, gloomy and abandoned — mossy grey weathered stone, dark greens and browns.
